hints.title: Extrema Participant Frequency Exclusion
hints.text: Find all activities whose participant counts are neither the maximum nor the minimum participant count across all activities.

hints.title: Having Filter with Subquery Min and Max
hints.text: group by activity and filter having count(*) > min_participants and count(*) < max_participants.

hints.title: Activity Participants Blueprint
hints.text: with ActivityCounts as (select activity, count(*) as cnt from Friends group by activity) select activity from ActivityCounts where cnt > (select min(cnt) from ActivityCounts) and cnt < (select max(cnt) from ActivityCounts).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH ActivityCounts AS (
    SELECT activity, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM Friends
    GROUP BY activity
)
SELECT activity
FROM ActivityCounts
WHERE cnt > (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM ActivityCounts)
  AND cnt < (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ActivityCounts);
```

complexity.notes: Group aggregation followed by subquery scalar min/max comparison runs in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Hardcoding static count thresholds fails when all activities have identical participant numbers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: CTE caches activity frequencies to compute dynamic min and max cleanly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exclusion of both global minimum and maximum frequencies using aggregate subqueries.
